Commentary.Commentary: A word about Ross Taylor now. How well did he play? An 80 in the first game, an unbeaten 86 in much tougher conditions here. He did not waste too much time, just took it till the end, ensuring that New Zealand at least batted out 50 overs. Has his team got enough though? If the Kiwis bowl as well as they did on Wednesday, we could have more than a contest on our hands. Join us back at 7.15 pm local (1515 GMT).

Reverse swing is a key exponent in Pakistan's bowling and the last few overs were certainly proof of that. The last 15 overs yielded just 72 runs with 5 wickets. Shaheen Afridi continued his excellent learning curve, picking up his best ODI figures and second 4-wicket haul. For some strange reason Faheem Ashraf did not return after bowling 7 overs while we had 25 overs of spin - for 80 runs and 2 wickets. Hasan Ali got 2 wickets but was not at his best.

The Kiwis had another poor start today, losing 2 wickets pretty quickly but then Taylor and Worker steadied the ship with a 46-run stand. However, at 73/4, it seemed like a lost cause before Nicholls joined forces with Rosco. The 75-run partnership seemed to give New Zealand the tempo but once the former fell, the floodgates opened.
Hmmm.... 210 is the target then. This is not such a bad score on this track. But one which will keep both the teams interested.
A full toss, whipped to deep mid-wicket for just a single. NEW ZEALAND FINISH ON 209/9.
Outside off, swatted through mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! Just over! A length delivery, on middle, Taylor gets his bottom hand into play. Uses his wrists and gets it over mid on. Long on thinks he has a chance but the ball just evades his leap.
Excellent reverse swinging delivery, tailing in off a fuller length, Taylor looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
On a length outside off, Ferguson just opens the face of his bat and steers it towards third man for a single to bring up NEW ZEALAND'S 200.
Lockie Ferguson is the last man in.
OUT! BOWLED! Perfect yorker. Hasan fires it at the base of the stumps, Boult backs away and looks to hit it through the off side but misses. The ball is too quick for him. Death rattle.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total. 5 runs from the over. Afridi finishes with figures of 9-1-38-4.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Trent Boult comes in at number 10, replacing Sodhi. 2 balls left. Can Shaheen get five?
OUT! BOWLED! 4-fer for Afridi. Keeps the basics simple. The line is on the stumps, the length is just a tad short of full. Sodhi looks to slog but misses. Timber.
TOP EDGE, SAFE! A length ball, slower in pace, IS looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air but third man cannot get to it. Two runs taken.
WIDE. Loses his radar. Sees Ish get across and hence bowls it down the leg side. But ends up bowling it way too far from the leg stump.
A slower ball, short in length, Sodhi swings a month in advance and misses.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
A slower short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for one more. 16 from the over, Hasan's figures read 8-0-49-1.
Yorker, around off, Ish looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Sets off for a quick single and makes it.
SIX! ADMONISHED! A length ball, following the batsman, Sodhi backs away and lofts it cleanly over long on!
FOUR! Does not matter if he missed out on the Free Hit. Makes up for it on this one. A length ball, around middle, Sodhi pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
A fine yorker on the Free Hit, dug out back to the bowler.
FREE HIT TIME!
NO BALL! Excellent yorker, dug out towards mid on for a single. But Hasan has overstepped! Free Hit coming up then...
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Hasan Ali returns. 7-0-33-1 so far.
Delivered with a change of pace, Ish backs away, looking to cut but misses again.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Another slower ball, on a length outside off, Sodhi looks to steer it towards third man but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side for a single.
Ish Sodhi comes in next at number 9, replacing Southee.

IN THE AIR... DROPPED... OOPS... OUT! Everyone is laughing. Imam is embarrassed while Afridi wants to laugh but does not want to hurt his teammate. A slower delivery to start, Southee looks to pull but is foxed by it. He mistimes it towards deep square leg where Imam-ul-Haq is a few yards inside the boundary. He has to run back, sticks out his right hand, but then the ball lobs up. Luckily for him, it does not go far and he is able to catch it in the second attempt. Third wicket for Afridi!
Shaheen Afridi is back. 7-1-32-2 so far.
Yorker outside off, Southee looks to drive but gets a bottom edge which just misses the stumps. Another single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for one.
Has a wild swipe, only to get an inside edge through square leg. A run results.
Outside off, pushed down to long off for a couple.
FOUR! WHOOSH! Full and outside off, Rosco comes down the track and whips it over mid-wicket. The ball nearly goes all the way. Bounces just in front.
Full and outside off, Taylor looks to play the reverse sweep but the ball goes off the bottom edge past the keeper through third man for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes down the trak and chips it over mid on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

SAFE AS A HOUSE. Full and outside off, Taylor pushes it towards point and sets off for a single. The fielder comes running in and has a shy at the bowler's end and hits the sticks. Pakistan reckon they have their man and it is referred upstairs. Replays though show that Rosco is well in.
Is that a run out? Direct hits are usually close. Taylor is the man in question.
Comes down the track and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Comes down the track and looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for another single.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle and off, played through long on for a run.
Full and outside off, Southee gets across and paddles it over short fine leg for a single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, well defended.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Short and outside off, Taylor looks to cut but misses.
Full on middle, bunted down to long on for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Imad Wasim is back on.
Closer to the off stump line, Southee is forward in defense. End of a successful over.
Beaten again! Turning away from the batsman again, Tim tries defending but misses.
Beaten! A leg spinner around off, Southee tries defending but it spins away to beat the bat.
Tim Southee walks in next.

OUT! Colin de Grandhomme holes out! He flops when New Zealand needed him to fire towards the end overs. Shadab serves a flighted ball on middle, Colin advances down the track and tries to go big over long on. But he fails to get the timing right and Hasan Ali settles underneath near the rope and catches the skier safely.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it to covers.
Tossed up ball on middle, de Grandhomme works it off his pads but finds mid-wicket.
Powerplay 3 begins. Now, Pakistan can put a maximum of 5 players outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Probably attempts a yorker but ends up serving a full toss, de Grandhomme clips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
This time Taylor leans forward and across to a full ball angled into him and then flicks it in front of square leg for a run.

Play and a miss! A sharp delivery, short and around off, angling in with extra pace and venom, Taylor tries to pull but misses. It goes under his bat to the keeper. Lucky for him, it didn't take any under edge.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Not out! It indeed is clipping the leg stump. Another delivery by Hasan Ali which has been angled into the batsman. Colin tries flicking it across the line but misses and is rapped on the front pad. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Sarfraz goes for the DRS after consulting his bowler but the replays show that it's clipping the leg stump. The umpire's call stays.
Appeal for an lbw, not given! Sarfraz has a chat with his bowler and then goes for the DRS. That looked close to the naked eye, let's see... Might be clipping the leg stump...
Angles in a full ball on off, it's pushed back to the bowler.

Sliding down the leg side, Taylor gets a faint tickles of his bat on his attempted flick shot and it races to fine leg. Hasan Ali chases it down, slides near the fence, picks up the ball and then sends in a flat throw to the keeper. Keeps the batsmen down to two. Brilliant effort by Hasan!
Eases a full ball down to long on for a run.
Loopy full ball on off, Taylor gets forward and presents a straight bat in defense.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and drives it through covers for a run.
Googly, a bit on the shorter side around middle, Colin moves back and turns it through mid-wicket for a run. 150 up for Pakistan!
Walks forward to a full ball and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Colin defends it from the crease to mid-wicket.
Brings a full ball back into the batsman, some sign of reverse. Colin tries flicking but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
De Grandhomme has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Colin de Grandhomme is the new batsman.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Hasan Ali foxes the batsman with a slower one. He runs in from 'round the wicket and angles in a length delivery in line of the stumps. Nicholls skips down the track and swings his bat across the line. But since it's a slower one, the ball arrives late. Henry is done with his shot way too early and it goes through to meet the middle stump. Pakistan have finally managed to break the 75-run partnership.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in, Henry tries working it on the leg side but it takes the leading half of his bat and rolls towards covers.
Angles in a length ball on middle, Taylor tickles it fine down the leg side for a run.
Hasan Ali is back on.
Skidding away from the batsman, Nicholls plays it down from the crease to point.
Taylor has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have run through for a single.

In the air... FALLS SHORT! Nicholls shows intent there. He dances down the track with the intention to clear long on. But he fails to get the timing right and it goes on one bounce to the long on fielder. A single taken.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Taylor pushes it with the spin to covers and pinches a quick single.
Skips down the track to a full ball and forces it down to long off for a run.
Full and flighted on off, Taylor drives it through covers for a single.
Lands it on a length outside off, it's driven through the line but straight to covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, slower in pace, Taylor runs it down to third man for a run.
Fullish and outside off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
FOUR! Well timed! Shaheen bangs in a short delivery around off, Taylor picks the length early, gets on top of bounce immediately and pulls it in the gap at mid-wicket.
This one is also on the fuller side but it's angled into the batsman. Taylor flicks it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Too full and outside off, Taylor tries to dig it out but fails.
Shaheen Afridi is back on. He's starting from 'round the wicket angle.
Walks down the track and strokes it back to the bowler.
Strides forward and defends a full ball to covers.
Quicker on off, defended off the back foot.

Fifty for Ross Taylor, his 43rd in this format! Reaches there by gently pushing a full ball to covers for a run. He's batting as per the demand of the hour and New Zealand will hope that he lasts the distance. His presence is very important if they want to post a challenging total on the board.
A touch short and on middle, Henry gets back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Flighted leg spinner outside outside off, it's driven through covers for a run.
Shadab Khan is called back into the attack.
Drinks.
Shortish and on off, Taylor gets across the stumps and softly plays it down towards mid-wicket for a run.
Deliberate edge! Ashraf hurls in a shortish length ball around off, Nicholls pushes inside the line and opens the face of the bat at the last moment. It runs down to third man for a run.
Pitches it up and outside off, Taylor bunts it in front of mid off and scampers across for a run. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Would have been close.
Good length delivery on middle, turned on the leg side through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Uppish but safe! A full length delivery in line of the stumps, Nicholls tries to flick it over mid-wicket but it takes the inner half of the bat and flies through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket.
Shortish length outside off, Taylor guides it to third man and crosses.
Width on offer outside off, Taylor reaches out for it and drills it to extra cover for a couple.
Eases a full ball down to long on for a run.
Another incoming delivery, Ross flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Arm ball on off, Taylor plays close to his pads towards mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, driven down to long on for a run.
Beaten! Tossed up ball outside off, Henry tries to drive but misses.
Angling into the batsman, from around off, Taylor brings down a straight willow and defends it back.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Nicholls gets back and helps it in front of mid-wicket for a sharp single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. 50 stand comes up!
Advances down the track to a length delivery pitching outside leg. Henry tries flicking but misses to get hit on the pads.
Straighter in line, Henry rotates his wrists to flick but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Reaches out for a length delivery outside off and drives it through covers for a run.
Taps it down to point but straight to the fielder. He collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but Nicholls is safely in.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
Arm ball on middle, Rosco closes the face of the bat and helps it through square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.

DROPPED! A quicker one just outside off, skidding through the surface, Henry tries to push it through covers but gets a big fat edge behind to Sarfraz. He fails to hold on to the catch and they cross for a run.
Sliding down the leg side, Taylor picks it off his pads and nudges it behind square leg for one.
Full and on off, forced back past the bowler to long on for a run this time.
Flatter and on off, shorter in length as well, Nicholls punches it off his back foot but straight into the direction of the bowler.
Bowling change. Imad Wasim returns.
Short delivery on off, from 'round the wicket, Henry pulls it to deep square leg and takes a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back of a length delivery on off, Taylor drags his pull shot in front of square leg for one.

FOUR! First boundary for New Zealand after 132 deliveries. Tells you how good the bowling has been from Pakistan. Hasan lands it full and on off, Rosco gets forward with a straight bat and drives it crisply past the bowler and mid off for a boundary. The Kiwis will hope that this boundary will break the shackles. The replays show that Ali slipped in his followthrough and that's why failed to stop it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A length ball around off, shaping back in a bit and staying low too, Taylor gets behind the line and blocks it to mid on.
Tossed up ball on middle, Taylor eases it to long on for another run. Hafeez is done with his spell, 10-0-31-1!
Flatter on off, forced down the ground to long off for one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Remains back footed and punches it back to the bowler.
Walks down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, worked on the leg side through mid-wicket for a run.
On a good length around off, Henry blocks it out.
Outside off, Taylor guides it towards backward point for a run.
Full and outside off, Taylor creams it through covers for a couple of runs.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball on off, Taylor pushes it to the off side.
Hasan Ali in for another spell.
Fuller on the pads, worked through square leg for another run.
Goes back again and punches the ball through the on side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nicholls rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Slower ball on middle and leg, played with a straight bat to long on for a single. That's the 100 up for the Kiwis and their last boundary was in the 8th over.
Fuller ball on leg, Henry uses his feet and hits it along the turf to long on. One run.
Arm ball on off, milked through mid-wicket for one.
Another front foot defense by Nicholls to end the over.
Flighted full ball on middle, Nicholls defends it off his front foot to mid-wicket.
Quicker through the air, on middle and leg at 91.1 kph, Henry gets back and keeps it out to covers.
A bit on the shorter side outside off, Taylor cuts it with the turn to sweeper cover for one.
Flatter and on off, Taylor goes hard at it with a drive but finds the cover fielder.
Nicely tossed up leg spinner, landing full on middle, Taylor shapes up for the sweep shot initially but then decides to defend it with a straight bat at the lats moment. Rosco smiles.
Taylor has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Gives this air on middle, Henry uses his feet and looks to flick it to the leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads to the off side to rotate strike.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Taylor comes down the wicket and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on leg, punched to long on for just one.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, worked to the on side.
Short ball and follows Henry down leg. The batsman drives it to the off side.
The wrong 'un, around off, Ross pats it back down the track and Shadab collects.
Takes the pace off, loops it up even more. Taylor drives it to short extra cover.
Steers this away with an open face and finds the point fielder.
Turning away from around off, a touch shorter in length, blocked from within the crease.
Spinning in, Nicholls turns it away to mid-wicket and takes a brisk single.
Tosses it right up there, Henry blocks with the full face.
Quick, short and coming in, Taylor goes back and punches it out.
Leans into the tossed up ball and knocks it to long on for a run.
From around the wicket now, it's drifting in on the pads, worked away square on the leg side. Double collected.
Goes on the back foot and punches it to long on. One more to the total.
A misfield from Hafeez. Nicholls punches it back down the track and the bowler lets it through. Single taken.
Full in length on off stump, solidly blocked from the front foot.
Floats up the leg break close to off, Taylor stonewalls it.
Short and wide, cut hard but straight to point.
Short, flat and outside off, kept out off the back foot safely.
Tosses up the googly down leg, Taylor looks to sweep but misses. Wide called.
Loopy full toss, flicked through mid-wicket by Henry for one.
Rock solid in defense. Shadab keeps it nice and straight, with some air on it, Nicholls with another front foot defense.
Looped up leg break on middle and leg, Nicholls presses forward and dead-bats.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Works it just wide of mid-wicket and gets to the other end this time.
Spinning in from outside off, Rosco uses the depth of the crease to go back and punches it towards mid on. Azam moves to his left from short mid-wicket and cuts it off.
Short, flat and on the stump, Nicholls goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Spears it in again, attacks the stumps, pushed it away towards covers from within the crease.
Darts this quicker on middle and off, blocked from within the crease.
Quicker through the air, the googly, Taylor leans across to get behind the line and defends it down on the leg side.
Nicely done. Just eases this flighted ball to long off and changes ends.
Easily drives this tossed up ball outside off to sweeper cover for a single.
Looped up outside off, driven to short extra cover. Dot ball.
Spinning away from outside off, Taylor has nothing to do with it.
Full and attacking the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Shadab Khan is into the attack now.
Short and flat outside off, cut away square through point for a single.
Full in line of the stumps, blocked by pressing well forward.
Quick and flat on off, a defensive punch is offered in response.
From around the wicket, it's darted full on off, it's played back to the bowler.
Works it with the turn behind square leg for a single.
Straighter one around off, played back down the track for no run.
Good bowling. On a good length closer to the off pole. Henry taps it down with soft hands.
Excellent! Yorker outside off. Henry looks to jam it out but cannot get his bat down in time. Luckily for him, it was outside off.
Full and on off, Taylor flicks it wide off mid-wicket and hurries to get off strike.
Short ball outside off, cut through point for one.
On a length and around off, it is stroked towards covers for a run.
Angles this into the batsman. He works it to mid-wicket.
A bit short in line of the stumps, punched back to Hafeez.
Short ball outside off, Henry gives room and tries to cut it but gets a bottom edge to it.
A bit short on middle and leg, Shadab at short mid on cannot stop it and they change ends.
Floated ball on the same line, hit to short mid-wicket.
Another flighted ball around off, given back to the bowler. Two dots in a row.
Loopy ball on off, hit back to the bowler.
Henry Nicholls is the new man in.

OUT! They have managed to break this stand very early! A corker of a yorker to do so and New Zealand are dented further. Shaheen comes steaming in and bowls it right in the block hole on off. Latham fails to bring his bat down in time and the ball hits the off pole. He gets his second and he was the one who ran Williamson out. Having a good time out there is the youngster.
Shortish and outside off, Latham guides it to point.

Did that carry? Yes, it did! But a tough chance there. Afridi bowls it on a fuller length, Latham strokes it uppishly back towards the bowler. Afridi in his followthrough gets down, gets two hands to it but can't hang on. Pakistan would love to break this partnership early as the two, built a huge one in the last game.
On the shorter side outside off, Latham times it to point.
Back of a length, that zips off the surface. Latham tries to flick but is hit high on the pads.
Lands it on a length outside off, left alone.
Taylor rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. A wicket and five runs from it.

Oh dear me! What was that? The ball slips off Hafeez's hand and it tosses this one high. Taylor waits to smack this but cannot make contact. The umpire signals a wide and the players see the funny side of it.
Flatter ball on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket to get off the mark.
With that wicket, the players will have some drinks. Also, Tom Latham comes out to bat.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The professor strikes. Bowls this full in line of the stumps, Worker comes down and looks to work this to the on side. He cannot get to the pitch of the ball and misses it. The ball goes and rattles the stumps. Important wicket for the hosts as this partnership was just about to build.
Rocks onto the back foot and punches this towards mid off. Shadab cannot stop it and they cross.
Slower ball on leg, flicked to mid-wicket and jogs to the other end.
Taylor works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the shorter side and Taylor is hurried into the pull shot. It takes the top edge and goes towards fine leg. Another run.
On a length and around off, the batsman gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Attacks the off pole, Taylor gets right behind the line and defends it onto the ground.
From around the wicket he bowls it down the leg side. It has been wided.
Length and outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man for a single.
Starts off with a length ball on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Shaheen Afridi is back on.
Slows it up and lands it on off, Taylor defends it off the front foot.
Another tossed up ball on off, Taylor times it to the bowler.
Loopy ball on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Fires it on off, Taylor goes back and works it to mid-wicket.
Dances down the track and strokes it to long on for a run.
Floats it on middle, the batsman works it to mid-wicket.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for another single.
On the pads, it is worked around the corner for a run.
Good effort in the field! Shortish and outside off, Ross slashes at it, gets it through point. Faheem from third man runs to his right, dives and saves a couple.
Good length and outside off, the batsman opens the face of the bat, it goes down to third man. A run taken.
Length again outside off, the batsman guides it down to third man for a couple.
On a length around off, Worker pushes it to the bowler.
Flatter and on off, Taylor pushes it to mid-wicket.
This is eased down to long on for a run.
On the stumps, the batsman keeps it out.

OHHH! Close! This was slower through the on the pads. Taylor goes for the paddle sweep but he seems to have missed it. The ball brushes the pads and goes close psat the leg pole and down towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
On the pads, it is flicked through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Tosses it up on middle, Worker keeps it out.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Mohammad Hafeez is into the attack.
A dot to end! 6 from Ali's second. Good length on off, kept out.
Good length and on off, Taylor lunges and blocks it out.
Down the leg side, Worker works it through backward square leg for a run. This is an expensive start for Hasan Ali.
Good length around off, Worker defends it towards covers.
Good timing! Fuller in length and on middle, Taylor strokes it through mid on and runs three.
Fuller and outside off, Taylor strokes it through covers. Imam makes a good stop but can't stop two.
Two dots to end a good over! Similar length and line to the last ball, it is timed to mid on.
Once again he angles it into the batsman. Worker strokes it to mid on.

A huge appeal but not given! This one is angled into the pads of the batsman. Worker goes for the flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire does not give it. It was going down leg.
Fuller in length on off, it is timed towards cover. The fielder misfields and a run is taken.
Good length outside off, Worker guides it down to third man for a single.
This is pushed towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! End of a good over for New Zealand. 8 runs from it. Worker shuffles across and flicks it over square leg and the ball reaches to the fence.
Good length on off, kept out.

FOUR! Comedy of errors there! This one is angled into the batter. Worker flicks it through square leg. Imam runs behind it, he collects the ball and then tries to pass it to the man coming in from fine leg. The throw though is a wild one and it touches the fence. Sarfraz is not happy and rightly so. He need not have done that.
Back of a length on off, Worker guides it to point.

In the air... but it was off the thigh pad. Also, no fielder caught it. On the shorter side and on the pads. Worker is beaten for pace as he goes for the pull. It hits his thigh pad and lobs beside the pitch.
On a length and around off, Worker defends it towards mid-wicket.
Hasan Ali is into the attack.
George opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Similar line on middle and leg, played with soft hands to the on side.
Length around off, Worker taps it in front of him. The fielders behind the stumps put in a appeal but the umpire is not interested.
A bit fuller and closer to the stumps. Worker on the front foot drives it to mid off.
Length ball outside off, hit straight to point.
Down leg again, this time worker around the corner for a brace.
Wide. Errs it down leg. Worker misses his flick and the umpire stretches his arms wide.
Back of a length around off, the batsman guides it to the man at point.
Fullish and on middle, Taylor times it to mid on.
Around off, the batsman guides it down to third man for a run.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
A little too straight again, Ross clips it through square leg and a single results.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Off the mark in style is Taylor. Full and on the pads, Ross flicks it through mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Good length and around middle, it is tucked to mid-wicket. A maiden by Ashraf.
Back of a length again on off, the batsman defends it out.
On a length and around off, kept out.
Another excellent stop! This is good from Pakistan. Worker drives it square on the off side. The fielder there leaps and stops it with one hand.
Full and outside off, the batsman drives it towards point. The fielder there makes a good stop.
Good length and outside off, the batsman shoulders arms.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
On the pads, it is clipped to fine leg for a run. Afridi seems to be struggling with his length. He is too straight.
Fullish and on off, Worker strokes it towards covers. Zaman there dives to his left and makes a half-stop, saves a couple for his side.
Ross Taylor is the new man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pakistan have got New Zealand's talisman in a fortunate manner. Williamson can't believe his luck as he walks back with his head down. It is a full delivery on middle, Worker drives it back towards the bowler. He gets down and the ball brushes his hands and deflects onto the stumps at the non-striker's end where Kane is out of his crease, for a walk. The hosts are ecstatic and they are right on top here.
Better from Afridi, he bowls it on a length and outside off. The batsman shoulders arms to it.

FIVE WIDES! Afridi has not got it right in this over. He bowls it way down the leg side, Sarfraz has no chance there. He fails to collect it and it goes down to the fine leg fence. 9 from 1 ball in this over.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor line, down the leg side. Worker tries to flick but misses. The ball brushes his pads and goes down to the fine leg fence.
Williams opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Angles it into the batsman, who works it to mid-wicket.
Fuller in length on off, Worker strokes it to mid off for a run.
BEATEN! A loose shot that! Short and wide outside off, Worker throws the kitchen sink at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length around off, it is guided to point.
Good length outside off, it is guided down to third man for a run.
Kane Williamson is in at no. 3.

OUT! In the air... and Hafeez has taken a superb catch. Excellent technique and that has been brilliantly grabbed. Afridi gets his revenge. He bowls it full and around off, Munro tries to flick it over the leg side but closes the face of the bat a touch early. He gets a leading edge which goes high up in the air and over the head of mid off. Hafeez there runs back, keeps his eyes on the ball, takes it with both hands and then falls onto the ground. Never easy when you're running backwards. Brilliant. Pakistan have struck early and that too a big wicket. The dangerous Munro departs cheaply again.
SIX! All the way! That did not seem off the middle but it has carried all the way! Full and on off, it was in the arc of the batsman. Munro lofts it over the long off fence.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Fullish and on off, Munro times it to mid off.
Full and wide outside off, Munro throws his bat at it. He does not get it off the middle but enough to get two.
A yorker to begin with. Munro is up for it as he gets his bat down in time and blocks it out.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Dot to end the over. Worker gets behind the line and bunts it down.
A bit short on middle, pulled to the on side for a run.
FOUR! Can't bowl there to Munro. Those bottom hands! Overpitched on leg, Munro lofts it over mid-wicket and the ball runs away to the ropes. First boundary of many.
Back of a length ball outside off, Munro looks to cut it but finds the man at cover-point.
Pitches it up on off, Munro drives it to the mid off fielder.
Comes from over the wicket and lands this on the  leg stump. Worker works it off his pads towards deep square leg for one.
We are ready for the action to begin. Colin Munro and George Worker walk out to bat in the hot sun. Faheem Ashraf will bowl the first over with a slip in place.
Team news - The visitors are unchanged. Faheem Ashraf replaces Junaid Khan for the hosts.
TOSS - New Zealand call it right and opt to bat.

Two different white-ball formats and different fortunes for the Pakistan cricket team. If they are scratchless in the shortest format then they are very much vulnerable in the longer ones. They lost their 12th straight game against the kiwis in this format and their poor form in 2018 continued. With Fakhar Zaman failing to give them the head start, their batting problem don't seem to end. On the flip side, with a lukewarm performance in the T20Is, the Kiwis have stepped up their game. Like they have done in past years in the 50-over format. A chance for them tonight to wrap up the series and take an unassailable lead. Let's see what pans out.
